name: Seedance 2.5
tagline: AI video generator creating cinematic 4K videos from text and images.
desc_full: Seedance 2.5 is an AI video generator for creators, marketers, and storytellers. It creates cinematic 4K video clips from text prompts and images through text-to-video and image-to-video workflows.
builder_bio: I am building Seedance 2.5 as an accessible AI video generator for creators and teams. The project matters because it helps turn visual ideas into useful video concepts quickly through text and image inputs.
builder_story: We are building an accessible way for people with visual ideas to turn prompts and reference images into polished video concepts quickly.
